Scoped, mechanical, donor fixture already named ⇒ auto-queue class rather than held observation.

Narrowing the comment instead (the body's alternative) is acceptable only with an explicit statement that the loader half is deliberately outside the guarantee — declared = enforced in either direction, as the body itself puts it.
